CurseConditions.Name: Curse conditions
CurseConditions.Hint: Add the Weredrake Curse and the Petrified Curse to the token status conditions. Forlorne's Breath Weapon and Stone-Cold Gaze apply them.

CurseVisuals.Name: Show curses on tokens
CurseVisuals.Hint: A creature under the Weredrake Curse takes the shape of a weredrake, and one under the Petrified Curse turns the color of stone. Clearing the curse restores the token.

Transform.Name: Forlorne transforms her token
Transform.Hint: Using Forlorne's Transform feature swaps her token between her Faun Form and Dragon Form, keeping her marked HP and Stress.

RollsToChat.Name: Post app rolls to chat
RollsToChat.Hint: Post the Night Sky Reading dice and the Villain Builder rolls as chat messages. Off: they are only shown with Dice So Nice.

Errors.NoGM: A GM needs to be connected for this.
Errors.Timeout: The GM didn't answer in time. Try again.

Refuse.GMOnly: Only the GM can do that.

Sky.NotRevealed: The reading hasn't been revealed yet.
Sky.NoAllyHope: The ally's Hope is spent for this scene.

Villain.Used: That prompt has already been used.
Villain.NotYours: Only the player answering this prompt (or the GM) can do that.

weredrakeCurse.Name: Weredrake Curse
weredrakeCurse.Short: Drops their equipment and loot and transforms into a Weredrake adversary under the GM's control. When cleared, they remember nothing of their time as a weredrake. Only magic can clear it.

petrifiedCurse.Name: Petrified Curse
petrifiedCurse.Short: Turned to stone with everything they wear and carry: Restrained and Vulnerable, can't act, +10 to damage thresholds. Only magic can clear it.

Curse.NoneCursed: None of your targets is cursed.

Transform.Missing: Forlorne's other form isn't in the Weredragon Adversaries compendium.
Transform.NotForlorne: Only Forlorne Lykona can transform like this.
Transform.NoToken: Forlorne needs a token on the scene to transform.

To.faun: The dragon's shape folds in on itself. Forlorne stands in her faun form once more.
To.dragon: Scales burst through her skin. Forlorne takes the stolen shape of the dragon Sazanthe!

Sky.Title: Night Sky Reading
Sky.RollHint: Together, roll five d6. Each player can roll a star.
Sky.PlaceHint: Click a lit cell to place a die with that number in its column, or drag a die onto a column. Click a placed die again to lift it out.
Sky.WaitHint: The GM is reading the stars…
Sky.RollFlavor: Night Sky Reading: a star for the Astromancer
Sky.Crowded: {cols} both send the party to {place}. Spread out where they have to go.
Sky.ClearDiceConfirm: Take all dice off the sky and let the players roll again?
Sky.ResetConfirm: Start a new reading? The dice, the placements, the ally's Hope and the checklist are cleared. Edits to the table, the journal and the whispered secrets are kept.

Rule.secret: Here the party can learn a secret that could help them defeat Forlorne. Every player writes down one secret Forlorne is hiding; between sessions the GM picks one to inspire the secret the party will uncover.
Rule.ally: This ally has a pool of 3 Hope at the start of any scene that includes Forlorne as an adversary. A PC within Far range of the ally can spend a Hope from this pool as if it were their own. If the ally falls unconscious or dies, the pool can't be used.
Rule.key1: An item with a defensive benefit against Forlorne. When Forlorne appears, a PC holding at least one of these items gains 1d4 Hope.
Rule.key2: A weapon that can harm Forlorne. A PC wielding it gains a +1 bonus to their Proficiency for attacks against Forlorne.
Rule.showdown: Where the party is most likely to face Forlorne in the final battle. If they arrive with the secret, the ally and both keys, Forlorne appears alone, and her Feed on Fear and Terrifying features aren't available while she's there.

Sky.SpendHope: Spend a Hope from the ally's pool
Sky.RefillHope: New scene with Forlorne: refill to 3
Sky.AllPrepared: Forlorne appears alone. Feed on Fear and Terrifying aren't available here.
Sky.WhisperPlaceholder: One secret Forlorne is hiding, about her history or her rule…
Sky.NoSecrets: No player has whispered a secret yet.
Sky.NoJournal: The reading hasn't been written down yet.
Sky.ChatTitle: The Astromancer has read the stars

Journal.Name: The Astromancer's Reading
Journal.Intro: From the top of Heaven's Eye, the Astromancer gazes into the night sky and draws the party's attention to five constellations.
Journal.SecretsIntro: Secrets Forlorne is hiding, as the players imagine them. Pick one to inspire the secret the party will uncover.

Villain.Title: Villain Builder
Villain.SetupIntro: Before character creation, the table builds the weredragon queen. Go around the table: each player opens a prompt, reads it aloud and answers it. Others can ask follow-up questions, and a player can pass a prompt to someone else or discard it.

Mode.slipsHint: Cut out, folded and scattered on the table. Each player picks one.
Mode.rollHint: Roll a d4 (tens) and a d10 (ones). Used prompts are rerolled.

Villain.SeatingHint: Starting with the player to the GM's left. Untick anyone who isn't playing.
Villain.WaitSetup: The GM is setting the table…
Villain.YourTurn: Your turn: pick a slip from the table
Villain.YourTurnRoll: Your turn: roll for a prompt
Villain.RolledUsed: Villain Builder: {n} was already used, rolling again
Villain.AnswerPlaceholder: Read the prompt aloud, then answer it…
Villain.ResetConfirm: Clear every answer and start the Villain Builder over? A journal you already wrote is kept.
Villain.DoneIntro: The table answered {n} prompts. Now on to character creation.

Journal.Name: Forlorne Lykona, as the Table Tells It
Journal.Intro: Built together at session zero with the Villain Builder.
